# Pezeex

> Pezeex is an AI-powered shopping assistant that finds similar, lower-priced product alternatives across trusted global and regional online stores.

Enter any product name or paste a product link to discover more affordable alternatives tailored to your country, currency, and preferred language. Pezeex supports 25+ countries and 37 languages with up to 25 free searches per day.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://pezeex.com/): Interactive AI shopping assistant for searching cheaper product alternatives by name or URL.
- [About Pezeex](https://pezeex.com/about): Overview of how Pezeex works, supported shopping regions, and affiliate transparency.
- [Contact Us](https://pezeex.com/contact): Direct email support at contact@pezeex.com and official social channels.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pezeex.com/privacy-policy): Information collected, cookies, GDPR/CCPA/PIPEDA/LGPD rights, and data retention.
- [Terms of Use](https://pezeex.com/terms-of-use): Terms governing use of pezeex.com, AI accuracy notice, and affiliate disclosure.

## Agent & Machine-Readable Resources

- [Homepage in Markdown](https://pezeex.com/index.md): Token-efficient Markdown version of the homepage (also returned at `/` when requesting `Accept: text/markdown`).
- [About in Markdown](https://pezeex.com/about.md): Markdown version of the About page.
- [Contact in Markdown](https://pezeex.com/contact.md): Markdown version of the Contact page.
- [MCP Server Card](https://pezeex.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-1649 Model Context Protocol discovery card for Pezeex.
- [MCP Endpoint](https://pezeex.com/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP endpoint exposing `search_product_alternatives` and `get_supported_countries`.
- [XML Sitemap](https://pezeex.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all public pages.
